name: Jump Jet
notes: Mount tons: 0.5 for 20-55 t, 1 for 60-85 t, 2 for 90-100 t.

name: Artemis IV FCS
notes: Artemis IV FCS: +2 on the cluster roll for the linked launcher firing Artemis ammo (CLUS-004); a hostile Guardian ECM bubble cancels it.

name: Beagle Active Probe
notes: Release 1 has no probe rules; it occupies its slots and weight only.

source.note: UZL-2S MTF lists it in the left torso; 1.5 t and 2 slots per the TechManual Beagle Active Probe entry (MegaMek ISBeagleActiveProbe)

name: Partial Wing
notes: One mount per torso. Release 1 has no wing rules; it occupies slots and weight only.

source.note: ERS-2N MTF lists four slots in each side torso; IS partial wing weighs 7% of chassis tonnage rounded up to the half ton, 3.5 t at 50 t (BattleMech Manual p.116; TacOps)

verify.note: RULING: the 3.5 t total is sourced; how it splits between the two torsos (2 / 1.5 in ers-2n) is ours and arbitrary, the wing has no rules in release 1; jump bonus not modelled

name: Clan Jump Jet
notes: Mount tons: 0.5 for 20-55 t, 1 for 60-85 t, 2 for 90-100 t.

source.note: AGoAC Weapons and Equipment Table (same weights as the Inner Sphere jump jet)

name: Improved Jump Jet
notes: Mount tons are twice the jump-jet value; the jump rating may reach the run MP.

source.note: MiscType (2026-10-08): Improved Jump Jet; 2 slots, weight twice a standard jet

name: PPC Capacitor
notes: Release 1 has no capacitor rules yet; it occupies its slot and weight. Intended hook name: ppcCapacitor (not registered).

source.note: MiscType createISPPCCapacitor (2026-10-08): 1 t, 1 slot; the same item serves Clan PPCs

verify.note: ENGINE: PPC capacitor charge/discharge hook (ppcCapacitor) is not registered

name: Clan Targeting Computer
notes: Mount tons and slots both equal ceil(sum of direct-fire weapon tons / 5). The engine gives -1 to hit to direct-fire weapons (EQUIP-001) while the TC mount is intact, and allows TC aimed shots (TOHIT-030/034).

source.note: MiscType createCLTargComp / cost code (2026-10-08): Clan divider 5 per ton of direct-fire weapons

name: Coolant Pod
notes: Release 1 has no coolant-pod rules; it occupies its slot and weight only. It adds heat dissipation and can explode in the full rules.

source.note: AmmoType createISCoolantPod (2026-10-08): Coolant Pod is an ammo-type item (1 shot); 1 slot and 1 ton from the MTF slot table and the Regent A tonnage audit

verify.note: ENGINE: coolant pod needs +1 heat dissipation per pod (hook name coolantPod, not registered)

name: Clan MASC
notes: Mount tons and slots both equal tonnage / 25, rounded to the nearest ton (minimum 1): 1 for a 25 t Solitaire. Release 1 has no MASC rules yet. Intended hook name: masc (not registered).

source.note: MiscType createCLMASC (2026-10-08): weight = max(1, round(tonnage * 0.04)) for Clan

verify.note: ENGINE: MASC sprint with escalating failure needs a hook (name masc, not registered)

name: Guardian ECM Suite
notes: Guardian ECM: a 6-hex bubble. Release 1 models one effect: hostile Artemis IV loses its cluster bonus when the attacker or the target is within 6 hexes of an operating Guardian (2026 [CL W38]: radius only, no LOS tracing). Probe, TAG, C3 and stealth effects are not modelled.

verify.note: only the Artemis effect is modelled; probe and other ECM effects are follow-ups
